headline: HOLD OUT 🧑‍⚖️ Juror DOUBTS 💭 Nothing on Lindsay's CHILD 💀 KILLINGS
text:
LONE 🧍‍♂️ HOLDOUT juror Michael Desronvil just DROPPED 📥 a BOMB 💣 saying he had ZERO ❌ doubts that Lindsay Clancy DELIBERATELY 🧠 planned and EXECUTED 🪓 the killings of her three 👦👧👶 children!! Based on all the PHYSICAL 📋 evidence key witnesses and what the prosecution PRESENTED 🎁 he thought it was enough PROOF 🔍 that she knew exactly what she was doing and mapped it out like a twisted 📍 DATE 🗓️ night!! The judge declared a MISTRIAL ⚖️ on September 4th after the jury spent nearly 40 hours 🕰️ DELIBERATING 🧠 without reaching a unanimous VERDICT 🗳️ leaving everyone RAW 😣 and edged to the brink!! Clancy admitted to the STRANGLINGS 👐 but her lawyers pushed that postpartum PSYCHOSIS 🧠 made her a helpless VICTIM 🥀 while prosecutors insisted the whole thing was COLD 🥶 and calculated like she was edging toward the CLIMAX 🫦 of her dark fantasy!!

The 36-year-old MOMMY 👩 was charged with three counts of first-degree MURDER 🔪 after strangling Cora five Dawson three and little Callan eight months at the family home in Massachusetts then LEAPING 🪟 out a second-floor WINDOW 🪟 like she was trying to finish the JOB 🏁 on herself too!! To convict her the jurors needed to be unanimously CONVINCED 🧩 beyond reasonable doubt that she intentionally SLAUGHTERED 🩸 her babies and that it wasn't the result of that rare and serious postpartum PSYCHOSIS 🌪️ condition!! The jury nine women and three men chewed over options from not guilty by reason of INSANITY 🤪 all the way to MANSLAUGHTER 🩸 and full first-degree MURDER 🗡️ charges!! Several other jurors spilled after the mistrial that the panel was split 11 to 1 in favor of finding her NOT ❌ criminally responsible but this one stubborn dude just wouldn't BUDGE 🪨!!

Desronvil said the evidence shown in court proved she had PLANNED 📝 the killings down to the last twisted DETAIL 🧩!! I didn't have any doubts he told CBS on Thursday as he tried explaining different possible theories during DELIBERATION 🗣️ only to keep getting CUT ✂️ off like the others thought he was secretly down bad and wavering!! Paula Devlin one of the other jurors told CBS Mornings the whole panel spent several DAYS 📅 trying to CONVINCE 🗣️ Desronvil to flip his stance!! We all worked together to convince ourselves once we got to that point where it was 10 to 2 she explained while the jury FOREPERSON 👩‍🏫 a retired fifth-grade teacher called the deadlock an absolute emotional ROLLERCOASTER 🎢 that left her feeling completely DRAINED 🫠 and raw!!

Another juror told local station WBZ that most of them had been very FIRM 💪 in their stance from the jump and the stand-alone juror wasn't the only one unwilling to see things from the other SIDE 🧭!! But they added that because Desronvil would not follow his own reasonable doubt or offer any logical reasoning for his POSITION 📍 the rest felt poor Lindsay never got a FAIR 🎟️ trial at all!! The identities of all 11 jurors haven't been officially dropped but in the US once a case wraps any juror can choose to SPILL ☕ publicly about what went down in those marathon sessions!! Patrick Clancy the children's father and Lindsay's ex is set to appear on 60 Minutes this Sunday where he'll talk grief memories of his kids and all the unhinged conspiracy THEORIES 🕵️ flooding social media since the trial kicked off!!

During the trial Clancy's defense team tried using the fact she was put on more than a dozen MEDICATIONS 💊 in the lead-up plus calls to a suicide HOTLINE 📞 and an emergency room visit as smoking-gun proof of her full-blown PSYCHOSIS 🌀!! A forensic psychiatrist testifying for the defense claimed she experienced a command HALLUCINATION 👁️ and a delusion of influence when she did the deed but her own psychiatrist who testified for the prosecution said she showed zero signs of psychosis during their SESSIONS 🛋️!! Another expert noted the condition isn't even currently recognized by the American Psychiatric Association which really threw a wrench in the whole INSANITY 🤪 defense!! Under Massachusetts law the prosecutors had to prove beyond any reasonable doubt that she was CRIMINALLY 🧑‍⚖️ responsible while the defense didn't have to prove anything about her mental state at all!! The mistrial leaves everything hanging and prosecutors still haven't said if they'll push for a full RETRIAL 🔄 while her lawyer Kevin Reddington is hoping to cut some kind of DEAL 🤝 to avoid round two!! He told Good Morning America he was UPSET 😠 that the lone juror refused to apply the law of reasonable doubt as the judge instructed saying that's not right and that's exactly why I was so heated!! The next court hearing is locked in for September 29th at Plymouth Superior Court in Massachusetts where this whole emotional EDGING 🫦 match will maybe finally reach its CLIMAX 🏁!!
